check_diff_summaries.start-times: START_TIME = race start printed in each race header of MemoSoft marathon results book https://cdn.paddleworldwide.com/media/2019_icf_canoe_marathon_world_championships_-_full_results.pdf (official results, ICF results archive); sheet_audit A/B/D
check_diff_summaries.crews: crew size vs class on MemoSoft marathon results book https://cdn.paddleworldwide.com/media/2019_icf_canoe_marathon_world_championships_-_full_results.pdf (official results, ICF results archive)
check_diff_summaries.OBS: DNS/DNF/DSQ/LAP verbatim from MemoSoft marathon results book https://cdn.paddleworldwide.com/media/2019_icf_canoe_marathon_world_championships_-_full_results.pdf (official results, ICF results archive)
check_diff_summaries.RANK vs official results: RANK = rank column of MemoSoft marathon results book https://cdn.paddleworldwide.com/media/2019_icf_canoe_marathon_world_championships_-_full_results.pdf (official results, ICF results archive) (rank_oracle)
check_diff_summaries.PERSONS vs ICF: PERSONS from bind_seat-accepted seats, printed names from MemoSoft marathon results book https://cdn.paddleworldwide.com/media/2019_icf_canoe_marathon_world_championships_-_full_results.pdf (official results, ICF results archive)
check_diff_summaries.repairs: name-bound seats vs printed names on MemoSoft marathon results book https://cdn.paddleworldwide.com/media/2019_icf_canoe_marathon_world_championships_-_full_results.pdf (official results, ICF results archive)
check_diff_summaries.fixtures: skill fixtures belong to other meetings; reference MemoSoft marathon results book https://cdn.paddleworldwide.com/media/2019_icf_canoe_marathon_world_championships_-_full_results.pdf (official results, ICF results archive)
